name: appa
description: OpenAPPA protection and policy tooling for agent harnesses.

plugins.name: appa-runtime
plugins.description: Gates a Claude Code session's flows through the appa-runtime process: every prompt, tool call, tool result, and child return is checked before it proceeds. Hooks fail closed - the runtime process must be running first. Only sessions launched with APPA_GATE=1 are gated; they start the runtime installed by appa init claude-code on demand.
